change: Preserve compiled human action cues at SURFACE_AT, exclude bare house words and suppress keyword delivery on complete machine envelopes.
notes: Existing frozen split has historical reuse; intervals are descriptive, not new untouched holdout evidence.

Human test recall decreases 0.625 percentage points; its interval is [-2.143, 0] points. The point estimate meets the existing <=1 point constraint; this does not establish noninferiority at that margin with 95% confidence.
All-traffic recall decreases due to suppressing compiled cues on complete machine envelopes. Do not describe all-traffic recall as preserved.
No live-provider or production deployment measurement. The regression property separately exercises spent deadlines and synthetic provider failures.

Native /claude-api slash commands are unavailable in this runtime. Used the existing production-function replay and programmatic grader, without a model call. The test split was scored but no new test transcripts were read to propose the fix.
Complete-envelope prompt false deliveries: test 14 -> 0; train 40 -> 1. Both exceed the original 70% reduction target. Prompt-clean is measured before tool events.

split.method: Existing frozen v2 split plus hard-case hash split; historical reuse disclosed in notes

verdict.statement: Envelope clean delivery improves; human recall and precision intervals include zero. Human recall point loss is within the existing one-point constraint. This is deterministic regression evidence only; historical holdout reuse and uncertainty are disclosed.
